items.title: India’s economy stays resilient at 7.1%, but rising inflation raises a red flag, says RBI's Sanjay Malhotra
items.summary: The Indian economy is projected to maintain a growth rate of 7.1% for the year 2026-27. This projection is an increase from the previously estimated 6.7%. RBI governor Sanjay Malhotra noted that inflationary pressures are rising, which could impact the growth outlook. Despite turbulent global conditions, India's economic resilience has been remarkable according to the governor.
